## Summary

[Partial] [Unverified value] Torque intake manifold bolts in a specific pattern and studs to 8 ft-lbs if removed. [t73]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] [Unverified value] Torque the intake manifold bolts in a specific pattern: First pass 5 ft-lb, Second pass 21 ft-lb.
2. [Unverified value] If studs are removed from the engine block, torque them to 8 ft-lbs.

_Procedure reported by [t73]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Follow bolt pattern sequence for front bolts: 5, 3, 2, 7 then 8, 1, 4, 6 [t73]
